For n<=5 independently enumerated connected graph isomorphism classes of cardinalities 1,2,6,21, solved PageRank rational functions, isolated all ranking-crossing real roots and tested each interval AND root point with exact Perron eigenvector principal cofactors. The tested statement is conditional on both winners UNIQUE: do not infer equality of full rankings or top-sets in tie cases. Exhaustive finite n<=5 and symbolic rational all-alpha proof establish the result.
